_comment: The CLI surface the stage table reads, and nothing else. Same design as the
regcf, sg-succession and chubb sidecars' pins: deliberately NOT a hash of
`l4 --help`, because any unrelated CLI change would fire a BROKEN verdict on
an otherwise fine run. These four enumerations and the module's regulative
rule names are the only CLI facts etc/go/phases/*.sh depend on.
fc23a49bff77b0ca...), JL4_LIBRARY_PATH at that worktree's jl4-core/libraries.
The four enumerations came back identical to the ones chubb pinned on
2026-08-31, which is the expected result and is recorded rather than
regulative_rules is EMPTY and 0 is the measured population: every module in
this corpus is constitutive (reward-programme eligibility and rates); there
is no MUST/MAY/SHANT anywhere, so p7-bpmn and p7-lts are not declared and
the bpmn discovery call would enumerate nothing.
